notes: Shipbuilder Robert Moran's 1909 mansion, now the centrepiece of a 30-acre waterfront resort; the mansion holds the restaurant, spa, museum and its original Aeolian pipe organ, but no guest rooms — those are in the village buildings around it (sources vary between 69 and 107 rooms). All the photographs here are Wikimedia Commons images of the mansion; the resort's own site is a Wix build whose gallery could not be scraped, so there are no current pictures of the guest lodging.
